description: This file implements a class named 'diff' which provides functionality to compute and display differences between two files or texts, including methods for diff calculation, inline diff rendering, and formatting code for HTML display.

classes.name: diff
classes.description: A PHP class for computing and displaying differences between two text files or arrays, with capabilities for inline diff rendering and code formatting.

methods.name: doDiff
methods.description: Performs the core diff algorithm to determine differences between two arrays (or files).

methods.name: diffWrap
methods.description: Wraps around doDiff to process and store the diff, tracking changed lines.

methods.name: formatcode
methods.description: Converts code into HTML-escaped format suitable for display, with spaces and tabs replaced by HTML entities.

methods.name: showline
methods.description: Determines whether a given line should be highlighted based on changes and padding setting.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Generates an HTML table visualizing inline differences between two versions of code.
